value.rationale: A complete all-length rank spectrum of the ordinary inner-derivation operators is a natural finite associative algebra invariant. It refines both the known degree-zero Hochschild center and commuting-pair aggregate, reveals cyclotomic resonance and rigidity under equal twist orders, and has a transparent but nontrivial all-length nonresonant polynomial. This provides meaningful structural classification rather than a table for arbitrary small parameters.
